name: Makina DUSD manipulable Curve accounting instruction
summary: Makina approved a permissionlessly callable accounting instruction that valued its Curve MIM/3CRV position through the pool's manipulable calc_withdraw_one_coin quote. A MEV searcher flash-manipulated that pool, invoked the approved instruction to inflate Caliber and Machine AUM, and synchronously propagated the false DUSD exchange rate into the DUSD/USDC Curve pool. Two cycles then removed nearly all of that pool's USDC.

loss.notes: Gross pre-recovery depletion of the DUSD/USDC Curve pool in the anchored transaction. USDC.balanceOf(pool) fell from 5,127,936.124721 at block 24273361 to 18,962.782093 at block 24273362, an exact 5,108,973.342628 USDC. The pool's DUSD token balance was unchanged. This measures victim assets rather than the searcher's smaller proceeds after flash-loan fees, manipulation costs and builder payment; later recoveries do not reduce gross loss.

ageReset.description: Makina's Safe scheduled allowed-instruction root 0xbb37df0ffb37a060429c68fd57b4224d3a679ab0adc95b1990898a653e608296 with a 172,800-second timelock. pendingAllowedInstrRoot() changed from zero to that root, and NewAllowedInstrRootScheduled log 706 fixed its effective time at 1768417787. No later pre-exploit schedule or cancellation replaced it. Reconstructing the exploit instruction's leaf and seven-node Merkle proof yields the same root, which accountForPosition accepted four times in the exploit transaction.

sources.note: Reviewed the official post-mortem, verified Caliber source, root-scheduling transaction, proxy deployment trace, exploit call trace, Merkle proof and pool balances. The index-0 anchor is the successful MEV front-run and calls Caliber.accountForPosition and Machine.updateTotalAum during each of two extraction cycles; the receipt contains four PositionUpdated events because each cycle also restores accounting after extraction. The instruction uses calc_withdraw_one_coin against MIM/3CRV and its proof reconstructs root 0xbb37df0ffb37a060429c68fd57b4224d3a679ab0adc95b1990898a653e608296, exactly the root scheduled in source 2 and returned by allowedInstrRoot immediately before the exploit. The 48-hour timelock made it effective at 1768417787. No later schedule, cancellation or beacon upgrade occurred before the anchor. Caliber proxy 0xd1a1c248b253f1fc60eacd90777b9a63f8c8c1bc was created by factory 0xde30eecf5293e5f5706895b10560d26f2621e4bc in source 3; its EIP-1967 beacon slot selects 0x3f5a881db86d6f495823028a1e892e7b2cd7e162, whose implementation slot selects 0x06147e073b854521c7b778280e7d7dbafb2d4898. The implementation runtime hashes to 0x4663e02890971dedd2e1b5086e371359f927792b78cd0ae32a40e95f3d9b9ed8. Finally, USDC.balanceOf(DUSD/USDC pool 0x32e616f4f17d43f9a5cd9be0e294727187064cb3) fell by exactly 5,108,973.342628 during the anchor while its DUSD balance was unchanged.

limitations: The gross loss covers the anchored drain of the DUSD/USDC pool; it excludes later independent trades against the dislocated pool and later recoveries.
